title: We classify students with a label we then put them on a bus where they go to a home without a label. The Hispanic, Black, recent immigrants and handic
summary: We classify students with a label we then put them on a bus where they go to a home without a label. The Hispanic, Black, recent immigrants and handicapped are no different in their need to understand and to know -Elsa Salazar Cade #quote
author: Greg McVerry
body_html:
We classify students with a label we then put them on a bus where they go to a home without a label. The Hispanic, Black, recent immigrants and handicapped are no different in their need to understand and to know
-Elsa Salazar Cade
#quote
